$description: Revenue Health Matrix system colors — used ONLY by the Matrix Zoom Explorer component (components/revenue-matrix-explorer/) to distinguish its 5 parent systems. Distinct from the general brand palette in colors.json.
note: These 5 colors are NOT part of the Marketplace Maven brand palette (see colors.json) — they're a diagnostic color-coding scheme specific to this one component. The explorer currently uses Inter as its font, not the brand's Instrument Serif/Inter/JetBrains Mono system — worth reconciling in a future pass so the explorer matches the rest of the brand.

softTintFormula.algorithm: convert hex to HSL, cap saturation at 65%, fix lightness to 93%
